title: Law officers: more on duties, ASGs, current affairs

boxes.title: Attorney General: added detail
items: Appointed on advice of the **Council of Ministers**
Referred matters reach AG via the **Ministry of Law**; consulted only on legal matters of ==real importance==
**Law Minister** handles legal matters at government level
**CJI** (Art. **124**): head of the judiciary, ==not a government law officer==

boxes.title: Advocate General: added detail
items: Duties under ==**Art. 165(2)**==: advise on legal matters + duties assigned by Governor or Constitution
**Right of audience** in any court in the state
By convention changes with the **state government**
AP: appointed by the **Governor of AP** under Art. 165; ⚠ current name not in notes

cards.title: R. Venkataramani
lines: SC asked him to relay directions to all Advocates General on ==senior-citizen facilities== (**8 Sep 2026**)

boxes.title: Debate
items: Convention of all law officers resigning on change of government ==ties the office to the ruling party==
